title: QuIVER pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow DSL2 pipeline for HCV quasispecies inference from ONT PromethION sequencing. Performs genome-wide low-frequency variant calling and haplotype reconstruction, with automatic mixed-genotype detection and per-genotype branching.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save outputs.

input.description: Path to samplesheet CSV file with columns: sample_id, fastq, metadata_json.

reference_panel.description: Path to HCV reference panel FASTA file (238-sequence panel).

host_reference.description: Path to human host reference FASTA (GRCh38 no-alt recommended) or pre-built minimap2 .mmi index. If omitted, GRCh38 no-alt is downloaded automatically and cached in host_genome_cache.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

read_qc_filtering.title: Read QC and filtering
read_qc_filtering.description: Parameters for raw read quality control and length/quality filtering via chopper.

min_length.description: Minimum read length in base pairs.

max_length.description: Maximum read length in base pairs (HCV genome = 9,646 bp; reads >10 kb often chimeric).

min_qual.description: Minimum mean Phred quality score for read passing QC.

genotyping_mixed_infection.title: Genotyping and mixed infection
genotyping_mixed_infection.description: Parameters for HCV genotype classification and mixed-infection detection.

min_secondary_fraction.description: Fraction of reads required to declare a secondary major genotype (mixed infection). Below 5% is typically artefact; above 5% is biologically plausible.

ambiguous_delta_as.description: Alignment score gap (AS) between primary and secondary hit to flag a read as ambiguous.

min_round1_mapped.description: Minimum number of primary-mapped reads in Round 1 panel map to proceed with genotyping.

coverage_thresholds.title: Coverage thresholds
coverage_thresholds.description: Coverage and depth requirements for consensus, variant calling, and haplotype reconstruction.

min_mean_coverage.description: Minimum mean coverage across the genome to proceed with downstream analysis.

min_consensus_cov.description: Minimum per-position coverage to call a base in consensus (lower positions masked with N).

min_variant_depth.description: Minimum depth (DP) at a position to attempt variant calling.

variant_calling.title: Variant calling
variant_calling.description: Parameters for LoFreq and Clair3 variant detection and filtering.

min_call_af.description: Minimum allele frequency for calling a variant (LoFreq internal threshold).

min_report_af.description: Minimum allele frequency to report a variant in final output.

min_mq.description: Minimum mapping quality (SAM MQ) for bases to be counted in variant calling.

min_bq.description: Minimum base quality (Phred) for all bases in variant calling.

min_alt_bq.description: Minimum base quality (Phred) for alternate-allele bases. Must be >= min_bq.

lofreq_sig.description: Bonferroni-corrected significance threshold for LoFreq variant calls.

lofreq_pp_threads.description: Number of LoFreq call-parallel workers. Values <= 1 use serial lofreq call instead of call-parallel.

max_sb.description: Maximum INFO/SB Phred-scaled strand bias score. LoFreq computes SB from Fisher's exact test on DP4 counts but does not filter on it by default. At high depth (5000x) the test is hypersensitive; SB=200 (p < 10^-20) was chosen empirically to remove multi-allelic clustered artefacts in repetitive regions while retaining depth-inflated but real variants.

depth_normalisation.title: Depth normalisation
depth_normalisation.description: Parameters for rasusa depth capping and random subsampling seeds.

lofreq_max_depth.description: Maximum depth for rasusa subsampling prior to LoFreq variant calling (sensitivity plateaus above this).

devider_max_depth.description: Maximum depth for rasusa subsampling prior to DEVIDER haplotype reconstruction (memory limit).

rasusa_seed_lofreq.description: Random seed for rasusa LoFreq subsampling (ensures reproducibility).

rasusa_seed_devider.description: Random seed for rasusa DEVIDER subsampling (ensures reproducibility).

haplotype_reconstruction.title: Haplotype reconstruction
haplotype_reconstruction.description: Parameters for DEVIDER windowed haplotype calling and post-hoc stitching.

devider_min_read_length.description: Minimum read length (bp) retained for DEVIDER input. Applied before rasusa_aln subsampling so the depth cap is drawn from long reads only. Short reads spanning few SNPs fragment the assembly graph without contributing phasing information.

devider_min_cov.description: Minimum per-window coverage for DEVIDER to call haplotypes.

devider_min_abund.description: Minimum haplotype abundance for DEVIDER to report a haplotype. This is a literal percent value: 0.25 means 0.25% (not 25%). DEVIDER applies this as a joint constraint with devider_min_cov.

devider_min_af.description: Minimum allele frequency for variants included in the VCF passed to DEVIDER for phasing. A higher threshold than min_report_af (1%) prevents low-AF noise variants from saturating DEVIDER's de Bruijn phasing graph and collapsing haplotype resolution. Must be >= min_report_af.

host_depletion.title: Host depletion
host_depletion.description: Options for human read depletion. Specify at most one method; nohuman is the default when none is specified.

skip_host_depletion.description: Skip host read depletion entirely. Not recommended for clinical samples where human reads may be present.

use_nohuman.description: Use nohuman (Kraken2-based) for host read depletion. This is the default when no method is specified. Database is downloaded automatically and cached in params.nohuman_db.

use_hostile.description: Use hostile for host read depletion. Requires --host_reference pointing to a hostile index directory.

use_minimap2.description: Use minimap2 alignment against GRCh38 no-alt for host read depletion. If --host_reference is not supplied, GRCh38 no-alt is downloaded automatically and cached in host_genome_cache.

nohuman_db.description: Directory where the nohuman Kraken2 database is cached between runs. Defaults to ~/.quiver/nohuman_db.

force_nohuman_db_download.description: Force re-download of the nohuman Kraken2 database even if a cached database exists in nohuman_db.

host_genome_cache.description: Directory where the downloaded GRCh38 no-alt FASTA and minimap2 index are cached between runs (minimap2 mode only). Defaults to ~/.quiver/references.

force_host_genome_download.description: Force re-download and re-indexing of GRCh38 no-alt even if a cached .mmi exists in host_genome_cache (minimap2 mode only).

optional_modules.title: Optional modules
optional_modules.description: Toggle optional analysis modules and fallback strategies.

run_clair3.description: Run Clair3 for corroboration of variants called by LoFreq (AF >= 25%).

allow_conda_fallback.description: Allow conda environment fallback if container image fails to pull.

clair3_model_dir.description: Path to custom Clair3 model directory (if null, uses Clair3 bundled default).

max_resource_options.title: Max resource options
max_resource_options.description: Maximum resource allocation for resource-intensive processes (LoFreq, DEVIDER, Clair3).

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs to allocate to a single task.

max_memory.description: Maximum memory to allocate to a single task (e.g. '64.GB').

gadi_project.description: NCI Gadi HPC project code (required if running on Gadi; e.g. 'vm52').
